[SWS_DM_00932] UDS DTC status bit 3 / ’ConfirmedDTC’ after displacement
⌈
If an event memory entry was removed during displacement
AND the configuration parameter DiagnosticCommonProps.resetConfirmed-
BitOnOverflow is set to "true", the DM module shall reset the UDS DTC status
bit 3 / ’ConfirmedDTC’ to ’0’.
⌋
